text:
Asha R: Quick mini-workshop — we need a compact console view for auto-fallback events that isn't scary to PMs but is useful for oncall.
Tom B: Proposal: single-line rows in the rollouts table that expand into a right-hand panel. Row shows: 'Degraded' badge, short reason, and tiny sparkline.
Kei N: Reason text should be one phrase: e.g., 'p95 latency breach' or 'quota reroute'. Expand to show metric snapshots only when user opens panel.
Sophie M: Auditors want an immutable event id and an export button. Export = signed ndjson bundle (decision event + minimal trace refs). No raw prompts unless explicit consent.
Asha R: Add a 'fetch sample' CTA inside panel. Clicking opens a consent modal that records who asked, why, and creates an audit entry. Default sample preview is redacted.
Tom B: Actions menu: Retry, Force-primary (duration), Pause-autopolicy (duration). All actions require role checks. Show small tooltip explaining scope of each action.
Kei N: Telemetry fields we need from infra: event_id, route_id, decision, triggers (latency_p95_ms, error_pct), score (if probabilistic), sample_ref, retention_tier, owner_team. Keep this minimal.
Sophie M: For retention_tier show small tag: 7d / 30d / enterprise-365d. If sample not available, panel shows 'sample unavailable — retention expired' with link to compliance request.
ops-bot: Note: Only users in group ops_oncall can force-route > 20 reqs. All actions produce an audit log entry.
Asha R: Include a tiny 'why checklist' that renders badges for latency, errors, quota, cost. Clicking a badge expands metric details in-place.
Tom B: UX microcopy: use 'Degraded to backup model' in public-facing surfaces; internal dev labels can still say 'fallback'.
Kei N: Add 'replay to sandbox' option which sanitizes identifiers. This must be enabled per-team; record KMS unwrap permissions if raw data is returned.
Sophie M: Export flow: generate a signed S3 link that expires quickly. Store export request metadata (who, why) in audit store.
Asha R: Operational runbook snippet in panel: 'If degraded rate > 12% over 30m, create infra incident.' Make it linkable to existing runbook system.
Tom B: API stubs: GET /v1/rollouts/events/{event_id} and POST /v1/rollouts/events/{event_id}/export. Add RBAC header checks.
Kei N: Backend shape note: store sample_ref as a stable hash; raw blob retrieval gated by retention + consent + KMS ACL.
Sophie M: Accessibility: ensure badges have text equivalents and the sparkline has alt text.
deploy-bot: Deployed: rollout-fallback-compact-view -> staging at 2025-06-14T11:30:00Z
Asha R: Nice. Tom, Kei, Sophie — can you have mocks + schema by EOD Thursday?
